text.en: Landing multiple hits turns your next shot into a homing micro-rocket.

Scoring 13 Hits loads a Tracking Missile which fires on the next shot. Missiles are removed on reload.

Tracking Missiles aggressively seek targets to a maximum range of 50 meters and deal <pve 148 /> <pvp [22.7] /> damage on impact.
